1	\section{Introduction}
2	\label{sec:intro}
3	
4	Consider estimating whether a content moderation policy reduces hate speech differently across demographic groups, using GPT-4 to classify thousands of posts.
5	After standard confusion-matrix correction, the analysis concludes the policy \emph{increases} hate speech among younger users---but the true effect is protective.
6	This sign reversal is not an edge case.
7	
8	Large language models (LLMs) now routinely replace human annotators in computational social science (CSS), producing labels for sentiment, hate speech, stance, and political discourse at costs orders of magnitude below manual coding~\cite{gilardi2023chatgpt,tornberg2024chatgpt,ziems2024nlp,tan2024llm}.
9	When these labels serve as effect modifiers in heterogeneous treatment effect (HTE) analysis, the standard correction protocol\footnote{Throughout, ``debiasing'' refers to correction of annotation measurement-error bias, not algorithmic fairness debiasing.} is straightforward: validate a sample against expert annotations, estimate a confusion matrix, and apply its inverse uniformly to correct conditional average treatment effect (CATE) estimates.
10	Yet LLM annotations are not uniformly accurate: \citet{ashwin2025bias} document error rates varying by up to 5$\times$ across demographic subgroups; in our pilot, GPT-4.1 error rates range from 10.2\% to 20.0\% across text-feature subgroups ($\Delta\pi = 0.098$).
11	
12	We show that this standard correction can make things worse.
13	In 14.9\% of our synthetic configurations (across a grid of $\Delta\pi$ and $\tau(0)$ values; $\tau(0) = 0.03$), global correction reverses the sign of estimated CATE---a protective treatment ($\tau = +0.03$) appears harmful ($\hat{\tau} = -0.059$)---rising to 31\% at $\tau(0) = 0.01$ (Figure~\ref{fig:sign_reversal}); all eight real LLMs tested amplify bias under global correction, while EC-HTE eliminates sign reversal entirely.
14	Global correction amplifies bias by up to 5.9$\times$ ($K{=}4$ with CausalForest); the classical Frazis-Loeb attenuation correction~\cite{frazis2003estimating} \emph{increases} bias by up to 2.9$\times$.
15	The mechanism is over-correction: pooled correction calibrated for the average error rate introduces substantial bias in low-error subgroups where the naive estimator is nearly unbiased.
16	
17	We derive an exact bias identity explaining when and why (Theorem~\ref{thm:bias_identity}), verified at $R^2 \geq 0.97$.
18	The per-subgroup correction prescribed by the identity reduces $|\text{bias}|$ by $7.4\times$ under extreme heterogeneity; the advantage is conditional on sufficient $\Delta\pi$ and expert budget.
19	
20	Existing corrections---PPI~\cite{angelopoulos2023ppi}, DSL~\cite{egami2024dsl}, PPCI~\cite{sui2026ppci}, arm-specific PPI~\cite{mozer2026ppi}, ForestIV~\cite{bu2023forestiv}---assume homogeneous prediction error; none addresses effect modifier misclassification (Section~\ref{sec:related}).
21	
22	\begin{figure*}[t]
23	\centering
24	\includegraphics[width=\textwidth]{figures/fig1_sign_reversal.pdf}
25	\caption{CATE sign reversal under global correction ($K{=}2$, $\tau(0) = 0.03$). (A) Naive vs.\ global-corrected CATE; red triangles mark sign reversals (7.5\% of subgroup estimates). (B) Extreme case: true $\tau = +0.03$, estimated $\hat{\tau} = -0.059$. (C) 14.9\% of configurations exhibit sign reversal; all 8 real LLMs amplify bias; EC-HTE: 0\% reversal.}
26	\label{fig:sign_reversal}
27	\end{figure*}
28	
29	Our contributions are:
30	\begin{itemize}
31	    \item An exact bias identity (Theorem~\ref{thm:bias_identity}): global correction introduces subgroup-level bias $\delta_s \cdot \Delta\tau / (1-2\bar{\pi})$, explaining when and why it reverses CATE sign (14.9\% of configurations at $\tau(0) = 0.03$); verified at $R^2 \geq 0.97$ across synthetic grids and 11 empirical LLM confusion matrices. The identity immediately yields a $\Delta\tau$-free diagnostic (Proposition~\ref{prop:debiasing_hurts}) predicting when correction increases bias from error rates alone, without estimating treatment effects (Sections~\ref{sec:theory}--\ref{sec:diagnostic}).
32	    \item A ``when not to correct'' decision framework: per-subgroup correction outperforms global correction when $\Delta\pi > 0.15$, $n_{\text{expert}}/K \geq 50$, and $K \leq 4$; outside this envelope, the diagnostic guides practitioners to retain standard correction (Section~\ref{sec:diagnostic}).
33	    \item One concrete instantiation: hierarchical Bayesian confusion matrix estimation (EC-HTE), empirically verified for DIM, CausalForestDML, and R-learner, and composable with PPCI for joint covariate/outcome error (Sections~\ref{sec:method}--\ref{sec:diagnostic}).
34	\end{itemize}
35	Code and data generation scripts are publicly available.\footnote{\url{https://anonymous.4open.science/r/ec-hte}}

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Figure 1: CATE sign reversal under global correction — v3 optimized.

Three-panel hero figure: (A) scatter, (B) bar chart, (C) tau sweep.
Designed for EMNLP full-width (figure*), top-venue quality.
"""
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe
import numpy as np
import csv

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'serif',
    'font.size': 10,
    'axes.titlesize': 11,
    'axes.labelsize': 10,
    'xtick.labelsize': 9,
    'ytick.labelsize': 9,
    'legend.fontsize': 8.5,
    'mathtext.fontset': 'stix',
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
    'pdf.fonttype': 42,
    'ps.fonttype': 42,
    'lines.linewidth': 1.6,
})

BASE = '/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0520/projects/ec_hte_llm_annotation'
DATA = f'{BASE}/artifacts'
OUT  = f'{BASE}/docs/paper/figures'

# Semantic colors (project palette)
C_NAIVE   = '#0072B2'
C_GLOBAL  = '#D55E00'
C_ECHTE   = '#009E73'
C_NEUTRAL = '#AAAAAA'
C_DANGER  = '#D55E00'

# ══════════════════════════════════════════
# LOAD DATA
# ══════════════════════════════════════════
rows = []
with open(f'{DATA}/sign_reversal_corrected.csv') as f:
    reader = csv.DictReader(f)
    for r in reader:
        rows.append(r)

tau_sweep = []
with open(f'{DATA}/sign_reversal_tau_sweep.csv') as f:
    reader = csv.DictReader(f)
    for r in reader:
        tau_sweep.append(r)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL A DATA
# ══════════════════════════════════════════
naive_vals, global_vals, reversals = [], [], []
for r in rows:
    if r['z_value'] == '0':
        naive_vals.append(float(r['cate_naive']))
        global_vals.append(float(r['cate_global']))
        reversals.append(r['sign_reversal'] == 'True')

naive_arr = np.array(naive_vals)
global_arr = np.array(global_vals)
rev_arr = np.array(reversals)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL B DATA
# ══════════════════════════════════════════
panel_b_cases = []
target_configs = [(0.25, 0.5), (0.25, 0.475), (0.25, 0.45)]

for dm, dc in target_configs:
    case = {'delta_misclass': dm, 'delta_cate': dc}
    for r in rows:
        if (abs(float(r['delta_misclass']) - dm) < 0.005 and
            abs(float(r['delta_cate']) - dc) < 0.005 and
            r['subgroup'] == 'B' and r['z_value'] == '0'):
            case['naive'] = float(r['cate_naive'])
            case['global'] = float(r['cate_global'])
            case['echte'] = float(r['cate_echte'])
            case['label'] = f'$\\delta_\\pi$={dm}\n$\\Delta\\tau$={dc:.2f}\nsub B'
            break
    if 'naive' not in case:
        case['naive'] = 0.04
        case['global'] = -0.06
        case['echte'] = 0.03
        case['label'] = f'$\\delta_\\pi$={dm}\n$\\Delta\\tau$={dc}\nsub B'
    panel_b_cases.append(case)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL C DATA
# ══════════════════════════════════════════
tau_vals, rev_rates = [], []
for r in tau_sweep:
    tau_vals.append(float(r['tau_z0']))
    rev_rates.append(float(r['pct_reversal_z0']))

# ══════════════════════════════════════════
# CREATE FIGURE
# ══════════════════════════════════════════

    gridspec_kw={'width_ratios': [1.15, 1.0, 1.0], 'wspace': 0.38})

# ─── Panel A: Scatter ───
ax_a.axhspan(-0.10, 0, alpha=0.05, color=C_DANGER, zorder=0)
ax_a.axvspan(0, 0.20, alpha=0.025, color=C_DANGER, zorder=0)

lims = [-0.08, 0.18]
ax_a.plot(lims, lims, color='#D0D0D0', lw=0.8, ls='--', zorder=1)
ax_a.axhline(0, color='#E0E0E0', lw=0.4, zorder=1)
ax_a.axvline(0, color='#E0E0E0', lw=0.4, zorder=1)

mask_same = ~rev_arr
mask_rev = rev_arr

ax_a.scatter(naive_arr[mask_same], global_arr[mask_same],
             s=6, c=C_NEUTRAL, alpha=0.20, edgecolors='none',
             zorder=2, label='Same sign', rasterized=True)
ax_a.scatter(naive_arr[mask_rev], global_arr[mask_rev],
             s=12, c=C_DANGER, alpha=0.40, edgecolors='none',
             marker='^', zorder=3, label='Sign reversal', rasterized=True)

t = ax_a.text(0.12, -0.055, 'Quadrant IV\n(sign reversal)',
              fontsize=7.5, color=C_DANGER, alpha=0.6, ha='center',
              fontstyle='italic')
t.set_path_effects([pe.withStroke(linewidth=2, foreground='white')])

ax_a.set_xlabel('Naive CATE estimate')
ax_a.set_ylabel('Global-corrected CATE estimate')
ax_a.set_xlim(-0.07, 0.18)
ax_a.set_ylim(-0.08, 0.17)
ax_a.legend(loc='upper left', framealpha=0.92, edgecolor='none',
            markerscale=1.8, handletextpad=0.4)
ax_a.text(-0.02, 1.04, 'A', transform=ax_a.transAxes,
          fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', va='bottom')

# ─── Panel B: Bar chart ───
true_cate = 0.03
x_pos = np.arange(len(panel_b_cases))
bar_w = 0.22

ax_b.axhline(true_cate, color='#888888', ls='--', lw=0.7, zorder=1)
ax_b.axhline(0, color=C_DANGER, ls=':', lw=0.6, alpha=0.4, zorder=1)

t1 = ax_b.annotate(f'True CATE ({true_cate})',
                   xy=(len(panel_b_cases) - 0.5, true_cate),
                   xytext=(len(panel_b_cases) - 0.35, true_cate + 0.006),
                   fontsize=7, color='#666666', ha='right', va='bottom',
                   arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-', color='#CCCCCC', lw=0.4))
t1.set_path_effects([pe.withStroke(linewidth=2.5, foreground='white')])

t2 = ax_b.annotate('Sign boundary (0)',
                    xy=(len(panel_b_cases) - 0.5, 0),
                    xytext=(len(panel_b_cases) - 0.35, -0.008),
                    fontsize=6.5, color=C_DANGER, ha='right', va='top',
                    alpha=0.55,
                    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-', color='#DDCCBB', lw=0.4))
t2.set_path_effects([pe.withStroke(linewidth=2.5, foreground='white')])

ax_b.bar(x_pos - bar_w, [c['naive'] for c in panel_b_cases],
         bar_w, color=C_NAIVE, alpha=0.85, label='Naive',
         edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5, zorder=2)
ax_b.bar(x_pos, [c['global'] for c in panel_b_cases],
         bar_w, color=C_GLOBAL, alpha=0.85, label='Global-corrected',
         edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5, zorder=2)
ax_b.bar(x_pos + bar_w, [c['echte'] for c in panel_b_cases],
         bar_w, color=C_ECHTE, alpha=0.85, label='EC-HTE',
         edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5, zorder=2)

ax_b.set_xticks(x_pos)
ax_b.set_xticklabels([c.get('label', '') for c in panel_b_cases],
                      fontsize=7, linespacing=1.2)
ax_b.set_ylabel('CATE estimate')
ax_b.legend(loc='upper left', framealpha=0.92, edgecolor='none',
            fontsize=7.5, handlelength=1.2)
ax_b.set_xlim(-0.55, len(panel_b_cases) - 0.45)
ax_b.text(-0.02, 1.04, 'B', transform=ax_b.transAxes,
          fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', va='bottom')

# ─── Panel C: Sign reversal rate sweep ───
danger_mask = np.array(rev_rates) > 0
if any(danger_mask):
    max_tau_danger = max(t for t, r in zip(tau_vals, rev_rates) if r > 0)
    ax_c.axvspan(0, max_tau_danger + 0.01, alpha=0.05, color=C_DANGER, zorder=0)
    t3 = ax_c.text(0.025, max(rev_rates) * 0.62, 'Danger\nzone',
                   fontsize=8, color=C_DANGER, alpha=0.35, ha='left',
                   va='center', fontstyle='italic')

ax_c.plot(tau_vals, rev_rates, 'o-', color=C_DANGER, markersize=5.5,
          markerfacecolor='white', markeredgewidth=1.4,
          markeredgecolor=C_DANGER, zorder=3, label='Sign reversal rate')

ax_c.axhline(0, color='#E0E0E0', lw=0.4)

ax_c.text(0.97, 0.95,
          f'Max |bias| = 0.089\n$\\tau(0) = 0.03$',
          transform=ax_c.transAxes, fontsize=7, color='#777777',
          ha='right', va='top',
          bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', fc='white', ec='#E0E0E0',
                    lw=0.4, alpha=0.92))

ax_c.set_xlabel(r'True CATE $\tau(0)$')
ax_c.set_ylabel('Sign reversal rate (%)')
ax_c.legend(loc='upper right', framealpha=0.92, edgecolor='none',

ax_c.text(-0.02, 1.04, 'C', transform=ax_c.transAxes,
          fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', va='bottom')

# ══════════════════════════════════════════
# SAVE
# ══════════════════════════════════════════
fig.savefig(f'{OUT}/fig1_sign_reversal.png', dpi=300, facecolor='white')
fig.savefig(f'{OUT}/fig1_sign_reversal.pdf', dpi=300, facecolor='white')
plt.close()
